verdict.rationale: Mistral documents downloadable open-weight models under Apache 2.0, with a 'Model weights' page that gives download links and usage guidelines, so users can self-host and tune the weights on their own data. However, the pack has no evidence of a hosted fine-tuning API or a documented fine-tuning workflow, and commercial derivatives reportedly need a separate Mistral license. missing for 10: hosted fine-tuning API documentation, first-party fine-tuning guide/tooling, clear unrestricted derivative licensing, hands-on corroboration of fine-tuning.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can fine-tune the vendor's models on my own data through a documented self-serve path — hosted fine-tuning API or tunable open weights
